description: Turn 1 (setup): Excadrill's Iron Head KOs Ribombee (after its Quiver Dance) and Gyarados' Life Orb Waterfall KOs Charizard (after its Dragon Dance), deterministically. The decision is the replacement: Abomasnow (Snow Warning) and Pelipper (Drizzle + Damp Rock) come in at equal raw Speed 85, so their start handlers run in either order (snow or 8-turn rain remains, 1/2 each); the fainted Pokémon lose fnt and the turn counter advances.
